full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting shows a fair-haired young man seated on a rocky coast with deep blue sea behind him. He occupies the center of the selected panel, facing almost forward while his head inclines slightly toward his right shoulder. His tousled light brown hair catches the sky light, and his pale face has a calm, faintly thoughtful expression. A loose white long-sleeved shirt with rolled cuffs sits beneath a brown vest or sleeveless work garment, with dark brown trousers spread across the stones. His forearms rest between his knees, hands meeting loosely at the center near the lower edge. The posture is relaxed but self-contained, with shoulders gently dropped and the gaze meeting the viewer. Behind him, a narrow band of dark blue water runs across the middle, broken by a few pale wave strokes. A tan rocky headland projects into the sea at the right. Above the horizon, a soft blue sky carries scattered gray-white clouds and visible rough brush texture. Large pale and ocher rocks fill the foreground around his legs, their irregular surfaces painted more loosely than the face and hands. The viewpoint is near the seated figure's eye level, making the coastal background broad but subordinate. Diffuse daylight from the upper left brightens the shirt, hair, and near side of the face, while the vest and stones hold warm shadows. The overall composition centers a quiet figure between blue sky and sea and sunlit earth, balancing observed anatomy with open-air painterly looseness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然主义油画呈现一名浅发年轻男子坐在岩石海岸上，身后是深蓝大海。他占据所选单图中央，几乎面向前方，头稍向自己的右肩倾斜。凌乱的浅棕头发接住天光，浅色脸上是平静、略带沉思的神情。宽松的白色长袖衬衣袖口卷起，外面穿棕色背心或无袖工作服，深棕长裤铺在石头上。前臂搁在两膝之间，双手在下缘附近中央松松相接。姿态放松却向内收，肩膀轻垂，目光与观者相遇。身后一道窄窄的深蓝水带横过中部，几笔浅色浪花打断水面。右侧一块棕褐岩岬伸入海中。地平线上方，柔蓝天空有零散灰白云和可见的粗糙笔触。大块浅色与赭色岩石围住前景的腿，表面不规则，画法比脸和手更松散。视点接近坐着人物的眼高，使海岸背景宽阔，却服从人物。左上漫射日光照亮衬衣、头发和脸的近侧，背心与岩石保留暖色阴影。整体构图把安静人物置于蓝天海面与阳光下的土地之间，以观察性解剖平衡露天绘画的松动笔触。
style_prompt_en: Naturalistic oil painting combines careful facial and hand modeling with looser open-air brushwork. Warm cream, pale ocher, and soft flesh tones are set against marine blue and a lightly clouded sky. Broken short strokes articulate water and stone, while fabric receives broader soft folds and selective highlights. Diffuse daylight rounds the main forms without theatrical shadows; warm earth tones in the foreground balance the cool horizon. A centered seated mass anchors horizontal bands of sea and sky, leaving generous breathing room around the silhouette. Surface texture remains visible throughout, especially in the less resolved environment. The overall effect is reflective, sunlit, and quietly humane.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义油画把仔细塑造的脸与手同更松散的露天笔触结合起来。暖乳白、浅赭和柔和肤色放在海蓝与薄云天空前。破碎短笔触描绘水和石，布料则用更宽的柔软褶皱与选择性高光表现。漫射日光让主要形体圆润，没有舞台式阴影；前景暖土色平衡冷调地平线。居中而坐的色团稳住海与天的水平横带，剪影周围留出宽裕呼吸空间。表面肌理处处可见，尤其在处理较松的环境里。整体效果沉思、被日光照亮，并安静地富有人情味。
theme_en: A fair-haired young man seated on a rocky coast before the sea
theme_zh: 一名浅发年轻男子坐在海边岩石上，背后是大海
name: Henry Scott Tuke
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
